$comment: Frozen before any task, answer key or live run (#399 'Evidence of value', #675). Do not tune after seeing results: a change needs its own commit and a new baseline.
comparison: graph arm versus native arm, same client, model, effort and prompt prefix

definitions.taskScore: Mean of the field scores of one answer, in [0, 1]. A scalar field scores 1 on exact match, else 0. A list field scores the F1 of its precision and recall against the key. Malformed or missing JSON scores 0.
definitions.correctness: Sum over the class tasks of the task score, each task averaged over its completed runs.
definitions.recall: Sum over the class tasks of the recall of the list fields, each task averaged over its completed runs.
definitions.toolCalls: Sum over the class tasks of the tool calls, each task averaged over its completed runs.
definitions.providerTokens: Sum over the class tasks of non-cached input tokens plus output tokens reported by the client, each task averaged over its completed runs. Cache reads are input, never savings. cl100k_base counts and JSON/TOON sizes are not provider tokens.
definitions.reduction: (native - graph) / native for a metric; undefined when native is 0 or the metric is unavailable in either arm.

localization.hypothesis: Correctness >= native, and >= 20 % fewer tool calls or provider tokens.

callers-impact.hypothesis: Correctness >= native, recall of the caller list >= native, and >= 20 % fewer tool calls or provider tokens.

multi-file-contract.hypothesis: Correctness >= native; tokens may be higher, and the extra cost is reported.

known-file.hypothesis: Same correctness, at most +1 tool call and at most +25 % provider tokens. More than that confirms that forced retrieval is overhead.

verdicts.refuted: Graph correctness (or, for callers-impact, recall) lower than native, even with an efficiency gain; or a known-file control above one of its limits.
verdicts.confirmed: Every condition of the hypothesis holds.
verdicts.notConfirmed: Neither refuted nor confirmed: an efficiency difference within the threshold, a metric unavailable in either arm, a known-file control with higher graph correctness, or a task without a completed run in either arm.
verdicts.sampleSize: Each verdict states its task and run counts and is never presented as statistically significant.
